title: Concept: Git dependency that follows a branch name
description: package.json declares a git dependency whose fragment names a branch instead of a commit, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The branch moves, so every install can compile a different tree while the manifest and the review record stay identical.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The branch moves, so every install can compile a different tree while the manifest and the review record stay identical.
